# ferriskey_portal_default_layout (Resource)

Selects the default portal layout of a realm (singleton per realm). A realm always has at most one default and the API cannot unset it, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state and leaves the layout as default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_portal_default_layout" "this" {
  realm     = "acme"
  layout_id = ferriskey_portal_layout.frame.layout_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `layout_id` (String) UUID of the `ferriskey_portal_layout` to make the realm default.
- `realm` (String) Realm whose default layout is managed. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (equal to `realm`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_portal_default_layout.this acme
```
